readable.sign_body: The Fell Road. North of here the moor is open to the sky. Go up in frost, rain, gale or heat without the right garment from these pegs and your body pays by the hour; come back under this roof and it stops on its own. The climb makes you hungry and thirsty: Wat's hut, east on the top, has bread and a trough. Orla's still room, west, has a draught that makes you strong for an hour (try the quern), and a lute (try the knucklebones after a song). The fold, east of here, is the same sky with everything on one shelf.
readable.sign_hub: Three roads leave this inn. North, the Fell Road: what weather, hunger and a strong drink do to a body. East, Tidewater Steps: tide, moon, night, a hidden stair and a cliff. South, Low Wardle: a village that remembers what you did and talks about it. Each road starts with a signpost like this one. A fourth road, west, is not cut yet. Nothing here is a trap: when a door will not open, the words in the room say why.
readable.sign_world: Tidewater Steps. The cave east opens only at low tide; once open it stays open. The cliff path north climbs to a drop you can only take safely with the rope that lies at the top. Down there a stair leads back into the cave. The cave hides a shortcut up to that stair; you will only find it by searching after dark. The door on the cliff top opens under a full moon. Look about here more than once: the words change, and by your third visit the shore knows you. The pools south are all of this with every door open.
room.cliff_path.description: A narrow path up the cliff face. The shore is south, the top north.
room.cliff_path.title: Cliff Path
room.cliff_top.dark_moon: A windy cliff top under a dark moon; the stone door east opens only under a full moon. The path runs south; a sheer drop falls away below.
room.cliff_top.description: A windy cliff top. The path runs south; a sheer drop falls away below; a stone door is set in the rock east.
room.cliff_top.full_moon: A windy cliff top under a full moon; the stone door east stands ready to open. The path runs south; a sheer drop falls away below.
room.cliff_top.title: Cliff Top
room.crossroads_inn.description: A low inn where three roads meet. The fell road climbs north, the shore lies east; the west wall has no door yet.
room.crossroads_inn.title: Crossroads Inn
room.fell_gate.description: A stone shelter at the foot of the fell. Pegs line the wall. The moor opens north, the fold lies east and the inn south.
room.fell_gate.title: Fell Gate
room.fell_top.description: Open moor under a wide, quiet sky. A hut stands east, a brewhouse west; the shelter is south.
room.fell_top.drought: Open moor under the sky. The air is dry as dust and no garment helps; drink, and keep drinking. A hut stands east, a brewhouse west; the shelter is south.
room.fell_top.frost: Open moor under the sky. Frost whitens the heather and the cold bites; a wool cloak would keep it out. A hut stands east, a brewhouse west; the shelter is south.
room.fell_top.gale: Open moor under the sky. A gale tears at everything; wrap a scarf round your face. A hut stands east, a brewhouse west; the shelter is south.
room.fell_top.heat: Open moor under the sky. The sun beats down and nothing gives shade; a straw hat would help. A hut stands east, a brewhouse west; the shelter is south.
room.fell_top.rain: Open moor under the sky. Rain sheets across the heather; only an oilskin keeps it out. A hut stands east, a brewhouse west; the shelter is south.
room.fell_top.title: Fell Top
room.sea_cave.description: A dripping cave. A [cleft](cleft) splits the back wall. The gate to the shore is west.
room.sea_cave.high_tide: A dripping cave. A [cleft](cleft) splits the back wall. The tide is in; the gate west will not open until it drops.
room.sea_cave.title: Sea Cave
room.shepherd_hut.description: A turf hut out of the wind, smelling of sheep. The moor is west.
room.shepherd_hut.title: Shepherd's Hut
room.shore_steps.autumn: A shingle shore below the cliff. Wrack piles up along the tideline. A [horizon](horizon) runs flat to the sky. Steps climb north, a gate shuts the cave east, pools lie south and the inn west.
room.shore_steps.description: A shingle shore below the cliff. A [horizon](horizon) runs flat to the sky. Steps climb north, a gate shuts the cave east, pools lie south and the inn west.

room.shore_steps.high_tide: The tide is in: water covers the cave mouth east and the gate will not open until the tide drops. A [horizon](horizon) runs flat to the sky. Steps climb north, a gate shuts the cave east, pools lie south and the inn west.
room.shore_steps.rain: Rain hisses on the shingle. A [horizon](horizon) runs flat to the sky. Steps climb north, a gate shuts the cave east, pools lie south and the inn west.
room.shore_steps.spring: A shingle shore below the cliff. Spring weed greens the rocks. A [horizon](horizon) runs flat to the sky. Steps climb north, a gate shuts the cave east, pools lie south and the inn west.

room.smugglers_stair.title: Smugglers' Stair

room.the_fold.title: The Fold
room.tide_pools.description: A shelf of rock pools, everything open. A [cleft](pool_cleft) in the rock, the [sky](pool_sky), the [water](pool_water) and the [shore](pool_shore) each tell you something. The steps are north, the cliff door west, the cave east.
room.tide_pools.title: Tide Pools
